name: Smugglers
description: Runners who move contraband cargo through the city and beyond.

typeUpgrades.name: Smuggler's Rigging
typeUpgrades.description: Two carried items are perfectly concealed.

typeUpgrades.name: Camouflage
typeUpgrades.description: Your vehicles are perfectly concealed when at rest.

typeUpgrades.name: Elite Rovers
typeUpgrades.description: Your Rovers cohorts get +1d to quality rolls for related actions.

typeUpgrades.name: Steady
typeUpgrades.description: Each PC gets +1 stress box. Costs three upgrades to unlock, not just one.

features.name: Like Part of the Family
features.description: Create one of your vehicles as a cohort (use the vehicle edges and flaws). Its quality is equal to your Tier +1.

features.name: All Hands
features.description: During downtime, one of your cohorts may perform a downtime activity for the crew to acquire an asset, reduce heat, or work on a long-term project.

features.name: Ghost Passage
features.description: From harsh experience or occult ritual, all crew members become immune to possession by spirits, but may choose to "carry" a second ghost as a passenger within their body.

features.name: Just Passing Through
features.description: During downtime, take -1 heat. When your heat is 4 or less, you get +1d to deceive people when you pass yourselves off as ordinary citizens.

features.name: Leverage
features.description: Your crew supplies contraband for other factions. Your success is good for them. Whenever you gain rep, gain +1 rep.

features.name: Reavers
features.description: When you go into conflict aboard a vehicle, you gain +1 effect for vehicle damage and speed. Your vehicle gains armor.

features.name: Renegades
features.description: Each PC may add +1 action rating to Finesse, Prowl, or Skirmish (up to a max rating of 3).

features.name: Veteran
features.description: Choose a special ability from another source.
